name: Pocket Camera
description: Private photo album with on-device face/object detection. Capture is human-operated; the module draws analysis over bounded images.

capabilities.reason: Open the visible native viewfinder; only you can press the shutter to save a private photo.
Browse this module’s private photos, including older captures, and request individually confirmed deletion or gallery copies.
Display bounded image pixels from your selection or this module’s separately granted private album.
Run local face or object detection and receive estimated boxes, labels and scores. No identification or upload.
